meta.name: cost-accounting
meta.description: Establishes what something actually costs — fixed, variable and mixed cost behavior, absorption versus variable costing, job-order, process and activity-based methods, breakeven and operating leverage, and price/volume/mix decomposition. Use this to set a price floor, explain why revenue or margin moved, decide make versus buy, judge whether a product line earns its place, or work out how an allocation basis is distorting a reported margin.

copy.tagline: 核算真实成本,拆解利润变动,定出价格底线
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你要算清产品成本、为定价或盈亏分析发愁。
copy.tagline_en: Calculate true product costs and set data-driven price floors.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to understand cost structure and make informed pricing or make-or-buy decisions.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会运用成本会计方法帮用户判定一项产品或服务的真实成本，区分固定、可变和混合成本，识别会计方法（如吸收成本法）对报告利润的影响，并计算盈亏平衡点、解释收入或利润变动是来自价格、销量还是产品组合。
howto.when: 当问题涉及成本核算时，如设定价格下限、解释利润变动或选择自制/外购等，技能会提供分析框架。

say.text: 请帮我算出这款产品卖多少件才能保本。
say.note: Claude 会区分固定和可变成本，套用盈亏平衡公式计算。

say.text: 为什么我们毛利率上升的同时库存也增加了？
say.note: Claude 会检查是否因按吸收成本法生产过多造成。

say.text: 请将本季度收入变化的金额拆成价格、销量和组合的影响。
say.note: Claude 会分别算出三者对收入的贡献。

howto.what_en: Once enabled, Claude applies cost accounting to estimate true costs, classify cost behavior, identify absorption-costing distortions in reported profit, calculate break-even, and attribute revenue/margin changes to price, volume, or mix.
howto.when_en: When asked about costing, such as setting a price floor, explaining profit changes, or evaluating make/buy choices, the skill provides an analysis framework.

say_en.text: Calculate how many units we need to sell to break even.
say_en.note: Claude will use fixed vs variable costs and the break-even formula.

say_en.text: Why did our margin improve while inventory also grew?
say_en.note: Claude checks whether absorption costing caused it.

say_en.text: Decompose this quarter's revenue change into price, volume, and mix effects.
